claims.statement: When MEMORY is off, attach returns messages unchanged; when on, Mem0 search/inject runs and schedule_record queues a background add that cannot fail the chat.
Guard classifiers and Mem0 extraction use CompletionBackend rather than constructing a second LiteLLM Router.
PII enabled without spaCy or the configured model raises PiiConfigError instead of passing plaintext.
PromptRepository registers LiteLLM langfuse_otel when tracing is enabled, and compiles named prompts from Langfuse or local prompts/*.json.
